name: com.gamecore.gameplay.quest
description: Catalog row 7 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.4): quests. Authoring: QuestDefinition with stages, ObjectiveDefinition (talk, collect, reach, interact, fact; alternative branches), rewards and fail conditions. Kernel half: one target per quest with the quest.status/stage/branch and quest.obj.<n>.count/done slots, the quest.start/advance/setObjective/fail/complete routes and the QuestStarted/StageEntered/ObjectiveUpdated/QuestCompleted/QuestFailed/RewardGranted events; rewards are delivered exactly once through the narrative outbox as inventory.grant with a request id. Runtime: QuestTracker (objective signals and level objectives to commands), JournalPresenter (IJournalView) and ObjectiveMarker. Editor: quest.addStage, addObjective, linkReward and simulate.
